newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Pop star Michael Jackson arrives in Tunis.
newsitem.headline: Pop star Michael Jackson arrives in Tunis.

text.p: Pop star Michael Jackson arrived in Tunis on Sunday for his first concert in Africa and the Arab World.
Organisers said the concert, part of Jackson's world tour "HIStory II", will be held on Monday at Tunis' main stadium of El Menzah with an expected attendance of at least 60,000 people.

"This concert will be of special significance for me because it will be my first in Africa and the Arab World. The people and nations of both regions have always held a special place in my heart and I always wanted to perform for them," Jackson was quoted as saying in a statement released by the organisers.
Proceeds from the concert will go to the National Solidarity Fund called 26-26 promoted by Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali to help the poor.

"I am particularly delighted that this concert will be in Tunisia, a peaceful and tolerant nation which cares equally for men, women and children. Proceeds from my concert will go to a national charity helping the needy and that's an extra source of satisfaction for me," Jackson said.
The "King of Pop" was cheered by thousands of youths at Tunis airport and his hotel in central Tunis.
Tunisian media said that hundreds of youths also flew to Tunisia from neighbouring Algeria, and also from Italy, France and Spain aboard 23 charter flights to attend the concert.
